webhooks.detail: No webhooks for Spot API. Event push via WebSocket user data stream (userDataStream.subscribe). Webhooks exist only for Binance Pay Merchant, a separate product.

evidence.quote: For Security Purpose, Binance will add signature for webhook notification.

sandbox.detail: Spot Test Network (testnet.binance.vision) with virtual funds, free API keys via GitHub login; periodically reset.

evidence.quote: Please note that these are not real assets and can be used only on the Spot Test Network itself.

rate_limits.summary: Per-IP request weight limit (about 6000/min per search snippet), plus separate order-count limits; 429 then 418 IP ban

evidence.quote: Requests fail with HTTP status code 429 when you exceed the request rate limit.
